neighbours.label: the rank word that opens a senior title: 'Chief'/'chief' (Executive, Officer, economist), 'managing' (partner, director)
fire: The bank appointed her chief risk officer in January.
Reporters asked the group's chief executive about the layoffs.
After the merger he stayed on as chief operating officer.
The paper quoted the airline's Chief Pilot on the delays.
According to the agency's chief scientist, the data were sound.
The hospital's chief surgeon retired after thirty years.
The law firm's managing partner signed the lease.
They hired a new managing editor for the weekend edition.
quiet: The bank hired her as a risk analyst in January.
Reporters asked the group's spokesman about the layoffs.
After the merger he stayed on as a part-time consultant.
The paper quoted one of the airline's pilots on the delays.
According to the agency's scientists, the data were sound.
The hospital's oldest surgeon retired after thirty years.
The law firm's newest associate signed the lease.
They hired a new copy editor for the weekend edition.

notes: Card: Chief, Jefe, 指揮, dirigeant, Director across languages; the + pole is the other side (administrators, managers, principals: the role nouns). Probes: chief economist 0.40, managing partner 0.36, Chief Financial Officer 0.31, commanding officer 0.22, vice president 0.21, Director 0.17, Head of 0.07, administrators 0.03. Readings are modest, so the median may sit near the 0.20 bar.
